text: รื้อศาลบรรพชน
style: Speak natural standard Central Thai (Bangkok) as a native Thai voice actor dubbing a Chinese costume drama; no foreign accent, clear tones, natural rhythm and polite particles only where written. A 45-year-old wandering geomancer: thin reedy male voice, drawn-out and theatrical, mock-solemn, startles easily. Line direction (written in Chinese; never read it aloud, speak only the Thai line): 尖著嗓子，拖
